name: Focal Point Redirection
description: Frame the objective as selecting an optimal "hub" node and powering paths to it from all t sources. Since the graph is a tree, any node in the minimal connecting subtree can be the hub, and the cost is identical to the minimal subtree. Models may incorrectly attempt to iterate over all possible hubs, leading to an O(n^2) TLE, or fail to recognize the equivalence to a simple subtree prune.
